title: 第25章 考核前夕第26章 重回教室
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
“霍小姐，幸会幸会。”
看到霍玲如此礼貌，没有丝毫刁蛮，尚凌空自然也不会落对方的面子。
霍玲，可是玄武御灵使学院的高级教师。
虽然只有不到三十岁，但是却是实打实的天才。
同时还是联邦圣城霍家之人，算得上是霍家当代天骄之一。
本身也是毕业于玄武御灵使学院，在毕业之后，霍玲选择留在了学院当一名老师。
通过这些年的打拼，才有了现在这么强大的实力以及地位。
不到三十岁的七阶七级御灵使，未来绝对有机会登顶九阶。
相比于霍玲，其他三位顶级学院代表的老师，明显年纪就要大上一点。
几乎都是三十多岁。
本来这一次，应该是玄武御灵使学院以前经常作为代表的老师来的。
但是这一次情况有些特殊，霍玲听说天辉城霍家竟然出现了一个天才。
既然也算是自己的本家，那么自己去招揽也就更容易了。
而且，到底是不是天才，霍玲也很好奇。
天辉城这种比较偏远的城市，究竟会出什么样的天才。
从小在圣城里面长大的霍玲，对于天才的要求，可是非常高的。
这一次，可是专程为了天辉城霍家的人而来。
尚凌空自然是知道，霍玲说的到底是谁。
天辉城霍家出了一个天才少女，这件事情霍家家主霍青山有没有丝毫隐藏的意思。
这是一个非常好的机会，可以提高霍家名望。

因此这种事情，霍青山怎么可能会刻意隐藏。
“霍仙儿，确实是一个天才，在整个天辉城的年轻一辈中，她都算得上是数一数二的。”
“在我们的天辉高校，实力更是名列前茅。”
对于霍仙儿，尚凌空也是知道一点。
不过，对于家族子弟，尚凌空不是特别感冒。
因为这种家族子弟，即使是培养起来了，也会优先报答自己的家族，而不是考虑联邦。
因此，相比起于家族子弟，尚凌空更加看重平民子弟。
平民子弟大部分都会得到联邦的招揽，进入军队，保卫城池。
虽然这些家族也在城池之内，但是他们优先考虑的，绝对不是城池安全问题，而是他们家族的生存问题。
一听到尚凌空竟然都这么说了，霍玲自然也是欣喜。
要知道，这次可就是专程为了霍仙儿来的。
content_en:
"Miss Huo, nice to meet you."
Seeing that Huo Ling was so polite and not unruly at all, Shang Lingkong naturally would not let her down.
Huo Ling is a senior teacher at Xuanwu Yulingshi Academy.
Although he is only less than thirty years old, he is a real genius.
At the same time, he is a member of the Huo family of the Federation Holy City, and can be regarded as one of the Huo family's contemporary geniuses.
She also graduated from Xuanwu Yulingshi Academy. After graduation, Huo Ling chose to stay in the academy as a teacher.
Through these years of hard work, we have achieved such strong strength and status now.
A seventh-level spiritual master who is less than thirty years old will definitely have a chance to reach the ninth level in the future.
Compared with Huo Ling, the teachers representing the other three top colleges are obviously a little older.
Almost all are in their thirties.
Originally, this time, it was supposed to be the teacher who used to be the representative of Xuanwu Spirit Envoy Academy.
But this time, the situation was a bit special. Huo Ling heard that a genius had appeared in the Huo family in Tianhui City.
Since it is considered my own family, it is easier to recruit them myself.
Moreover, Huo Ling was also curious about whether he was a genius.
What kind of geniuses could come out of a relatively remote city like Tianhui City?
Huo Ling, who grew up in the Holy City, has very high requirements for geniuses.
This time, he came specifically for the people of the Huo family in Tianhui City.
Shang Lingkong naturally knew who Huo Ling was talking about.
A genius girl was born in Tianhui City's Huo family. Did Huo Qingshan, the head of the Huo family, have any hidden intentions about this matter?
This is a very good opportunity to improve the Huo family's reputation.
Therefore, how could Huo Qingshan deliberately hide such a thing.
"Huo Xian'er is indeed a genius. Among the younger generation in Tianhui City, she is considered one of the best."
"In our Tianhui University, the strength is among the best."
Shang Lingkong also knew a little about Huo Xian'er.
However, Shang Lingkong is not particularly cold to the children of the family.
Because the children of this kind of family, even if they are cultivated, will give priority to repaying their own family instead of considering the federation.
Therefore, Shang Lingkong valued the children of common people more than the children of his family.
Most civilians will be recruited by the federation to join the army and defend the city.
Although these families are also within the city, their priority is definitely not the safety of the city, but the survival of their families.
Huo Ling was naturally delighted when she heard Shang Lingkong said this.
You know, this time I came here specifically for Huo Xianer.
